audience: Greek businesses that issue invoices to myDATA through Wrapp

useCases.title: Check which invoices reached myDATA
useCases.text: List the invoices issued in a date range. Open one to see its status and myDATA mark.

useCases.title: Download an invoice PDF
useCases.text: Get the PDF of an issued invoice. The first call starts generation, and later calls return the download link.

useCases.title: Fill in a customer's company details
useCases.text: Look up a company by its VAT number and country. Use the name and address in an invoice.

useCases.title: Save and delete draft invoices
useCases.text: Save an invoice as a draft with a unique external id. A draft is never sent to myDATA. Delete a draft that you do not need.

useCases.title: Review branches and billing books
useCases.text: List the branches and billing books of the company, and count the issued invoices.
